premise: Acorn wants to be as big as the great trees right now; Squirrel tucks her into the soft earth before the snow, and when the spring sun comes Acorn feels a tickle in her toes — a root growing down first.
inspiration: "Great oaks from little acorns grow" (proverb) and the small-seed folk motif, turned toward patience: the first growing happens where nobody can see it.
lesson: Big things start small, and some growing happens out of sight.
learning: An acorn grows a root down into the ground first, before its shoot grows up.

en-US.title: Acorn Wants to Be a Tree
en-US.text: {acorn:enter} Acorn looked up at the two great trees. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live talk} [excited] "I want to be big like them. Right NOW!" Along came {squirrel:enter} Squirrel, bounding. [giggles] "Right now? Big trees start small, little one. Down in the ground." {squirrel:go to acorn} So, before the first snow, Squirrel {squirrel:live bury} {sfx:pat} tucked Acorn into the soft earth, pat, pat, pat. {squirrel:hearts} Close by, {flower:enter} {acorn:go to flower} Flower {flower:tint #BFE3FF} shivered. "I'll wait with you," she said, and {flower:live close hold} folded up tight. {canvas:snow 0.6} Then the snowflakes came. {acorn:live wish hold} Acorn squeezed her eyes tight and wished. "Grow… grow… GROW!" But nothing happened. [softly] Not that day, and not the next. She waited all winter long. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Then one morning the sun came back and melted the snow away. {flower:live close resume} Flower opened wide. And Acorn felt a tickle in her toes. {acorn:live wish resume} [gasps] "Am I a tree?" {acorn:face surprised} {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:live shake-head} "Not yet," said Squirrel. "That's your root, going down first. Your shoot comes up next." {acorn:face happy} {acorn:glow} Down first, then up! [softly] And for once, Acorn didn't mind waiting one little bit.

es-ES.title: Bellota quiere ser un árbol
es-ES.text: {acorn:enter} Bellota miraba los dos árboles grandes. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live talk} [excited] —¡Yo quiero ser así de grande! ¡Ahora MISMO! Y llegó {squirrel:enter} Ardilla, dando brincos. [giggles] —¿Ahora mismo? Los árboles grandes empiezan pequeñitos, bajo tierra. {squirrel:go to acorn} Así que, antes de las primeras nieves, Ardilla {squirrel:live bury} {sfx:pat} arropó a Bellota en la tierra blanda: pom, pom, pom. {squirrel:hearts} Muy cerca, {flower:enter} {acorn:go to flower} Flor {flower:tint #BFE3FF} tiritaba. —Yo espero contigo —le dijo, y {flower:live close hold} se cerró bien cerradita. {canvas:snow 0.6} Y empezó a nevar. {acorn:live wish hold} Bellota apretó los ojos y pidió un deseo: —¡Crecer… crecer… CRECER! Pero no pasó nada. [softly] Ni ese día, ni el siguiente. Esperó todo el invierno. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Hasta que una mañana volvió el sol y derritió la nieve. {flower:live close resume} Flor se abrió de par en par. Y Bellota sintió cosquillas en los pies. {acorn:live wish resume} [gasps] —¿Ya soy un árbol? {acorn:face surprised} {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:live shake-head} —Todavía no —dijo Ardilla—. Es tu raíz, que baja primero. Luego sube el tallo. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:glow} ¡Primero abajo y luego arriba! [softly] Y, por una vez, a Bellota no le importó nada esperar.

ja-JP.title: どんぐり、木になりたい
ja-JP.text: {acorn:enter}どんぐりは、二本の大きな木を見上げました。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:live talk}[excited]「あんなに大きくなりたい。いますぐ！」 そこへ{squirrel:enter}リスさんが、ぴょんぴょん。[giggles]「いますぐ？大きな木も、はじめは小さいの。土のなかからね。」 {squirrel:go to acorn}雪がふるまえに、リスさんは{squirrel:live bury}{sfx:pat}どんぐりを、やわらかい土にねかせました。ぽん、ぽん、ぽん。{squirrel:hearts}すぐそばで、{flower:enter}{acorn:go to flower}お花が{flower:tint #BFE3FF}ぶるるっ。「いっしょにまってるね」 と、{flower:live close hold}きゅっとつぼみになりました。{canvas:snow 0.6}やがて、雪がちらちら。{acorn:live wish hold}目をぎゅっとつぶって、「大きくなあれ…大きくなあれ！」 でも、なんにもおこりません。[softly]つぎの日も、そのつぎの日も。ふゆのあいだ、ずっと。{canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s}{sfx:birds}ある朝、おひさまがもどって、雪をとかしました。{flower:live close resume}お花が、ぱあっとひらきます。すると、どんぐりの足が、むずむず。{acorn:live wish resume}[gasps]「わたし、木になった？」 {acorn:face surprised}{squirrel:face happy}{squirrel:live shake-head}「まだよ」 とリスさん。「それはねっこ。さきに下へのびるの。芽が出るのは、そのあと。」 {acorn:face happy}{acorn:glow}さきに下、それから上！[softly]こんどばかりは、まつのもへっちゃらでした。

de-DE.title: Die Eichel will ein Baum sein
de-DE.text: {acorn:enter} Die Eichel sah zu den zwei großen Bäumen hinauf. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live talk} [excited] „So groß will ich auch sein. SOFORT!“ Da kam {squirrel:enter} das Eichhörnchen angesprungen. [giggles] „Sofort? Große Bäume fangen klein an, unten in der Erde.“ {squirrel:go to acorn} Noch vor dem ersten Schnee {squirrel:live bury} {sfx:pat} bettete es die Eichel in die weiche Erde, klopf, klopf, klopf. {squirrel:hearts} Daneben stand {flower:enter} {acorn:go to flower} die Blume und {flower:tint #BFE3FF} fröstelte. „Ich warte mit dir“, sagte sie und {flower:live close hold} machte sich fest zu. {canvas:snow 0.6} Dann schneite es. {acorn:live wish hold} Die Eichel wünschte sich ganz fest: „Wachsen… wachsen… WACHSEN!“ Doch nichts geschah. [softly] Nicht an diesem Tag, nicht am nächsten. Sie wartete den ganzen Winter. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Eines Morgens kam die Sonne zurück und schmolz den Schnee. {flower:live close resume} Die Blume ging weit auf. Und der Eichel kribbelte es in den Zehen. {acorn:live wish resume} [gasps] „Bin ich jetzt ein Baum?“ {acorn:face surprised} {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:live shake-head} „Noch nicht“, sagte das Eichhörnchen. „Das ist deine Wurzel. Die wächst zuerst nach unten, dann dein Spross nach oben.“ {acorn:face happy} {acorn:glow} Erst runter, dann rauf! [softly] Diesmal machte ihr das Warten gar nichts aus.

fr-FR.title: Gland veut devenir un arbre
fr-FR.text: {acorn:enter} Gland regardait les deux grands arbres. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live talk} [excited] « Je veux être grand comme eux. Tout de SUITE ! » {squirrel:enter} Écureuil est arrivé en bondissant. [giggles] « Tout de suite ? Les grands arbres commencent tout petits, sous la terre. » {squirrel:go to acorn} Avant les premières neiges, Écureuil {squirrel:live bury} {sfx:pat} a bordé Gland dans la terre douce, tap, tap, tap. {squirrel:hearts} Tout près, {flower:enter} {acorn:go to flower} Fleur {flower:tint #BFE3FF} frissonnait. « J’attends avec toi », a-t-elle dit, et {flower:live close hold} elle s’est refermée bien serré. {canvas:snow 0.6} Puis les flocons sont tombés. {acorn:live wish hold} Les yeux bien fermés, Gland a fait un vœu. « Pousse… pousse… POUSSE ! » Mais rien. [softly] Ni ce jour-là, ni le lendemain. Il a attendu tout l’hiver. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Un matin, le soleil est revenu et la neige a fondu. {flower:live close resume} Fleur s’est ouverte en grand. Et ça a chatouillé Gland sous les pieds. {acorn:live wish resume} [gasps] « Je suis un arbre ? » {acorn:face surprised} {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:live shake-head} « Pas encore, a dit Écureuil. C’est ta racine : elle descend d’abord. Ta pousse montera après. » {acorn:face happy} {acorn:glow} D’abord en bas, puis en haut ! [softly] Et pour une fois, Gland voulait bien attendre.

it-IT.title: Ghianda vuole diventare un albero
it-IT.text: {acorn:enter} Ghianda guardava in su, verso i due grandi alberi. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:live talk} [excited] «Voglio diventare grande come loro. Subito, ADESSO!» Ed ecco arrivare {squirrel:enter} Scoiattolo, a balzi. [giggles] «Adesso? Anche gli alberi più grandi cominciano piccoli, piccolina mia. Giù, sotto terra.» {squirrel:go to acorn} Così, prima che arrivasse la neve, Scoiattolo {squirrel:live bury} {sfx:pat} ha sistemato Ghianda nella terra morbida, come sotto una copertina: tap, tap, tap. {squirrel:hearts} Lì vicino, {flower:enter} {acorn:go to flower} Fiore {flower:tint #BFE3FF} tremava di freddo. «Aspetto con te», ha detto, e {flower:live close hold} si è chiuso stretto stretto. {canvas:snow 0.6} Poi sono arrivati i fiocchi di neve. {acorn:live wish hold} Ghianda ha stretto forte gli occhi e ha espresso un desiderio: «Cresci… cresci… CRESCI!» Ma non è successo niente. [softly] Né quel giorno, né quello dopo. Ha aspettato per tutto l'inverno. {canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s} {sfx:birds} Poi una mattina è tornato il sole e ha sciolto la neve. {flower:live close resume} Fiore si è aperto tutto. E Ghianda ha sentito un solletico ai piedini. {acorn:live wish resume} [gasps] «Sono diventata un albero?» {acorn:face surprised} {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:live shake-head} «Non ancora», ha detto Scoiattolo. «È la tua radice, che scende giù per prima. Poi verrà su il germoglio.» {acorn:face happy} {acorn:glow} Prima giù, e poi su! [softly] E per una volta, a Ghianda non è dispiaciuto per niente aspettare.

zh-TW.title: 橡實想變成大樹
zh-TW.text: {acorn:enter}橡實抬起頭，望著那兩棵好大好大的樹。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:live talk}[excited]「我也要長得跟它們一樣大。現在就要！」 {squirrel:enter}松鼠蹦蹦跳跳地來了。[giggles]「現在就要？小傢伙，大樹都是從小小的開始長，就在土裡面喔。」 {squirrel:go to acorn}所以，第一場雪來之前，松鼠{squirrel:live bury}{sfx:pat}把橡實蓋進軟軟的泥土裡，拍拍、拍拍、拍拍。{squirrel:hearts}旁邊的{flower:enter}{acorn:go to flower}小花{flower:tint #BFE3FF}冷得直發抖。「我陪你一起等。」 她說完，{flower:live close hold}把花瓣緊緊合起來。{canvas:snow 0.6}接著，雪花飄下來了。{acorn:live wish hold}橡實緊緊閉上眼睛許願：「長大……長大……快長大！」 可是，什麼事也沒發生。[softly]那天沒有，隔天也沒有。她等了一整個冬天。{canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s}{sfx:birds}有一天早上，太陽回來了，把雪都融化了。{flower:live close resume}小花張開了花瓣。橡實覺得腳趾頭癢癢的。{acorn:live wish resume}[gasps]「我變成大樹了嗎？」 {acorn:face surprised}{squirrel:face happy}{squirrel:live shake-head}「還沒喔。」 松鼠說，「那是你的根，先往下長。接下來，你的芽才會往上冒。」 {acorn:face happy}{acorn:glow}先往下，再往上！[softly]這一次，橡實一點也不介意慢慢等了。

zh-HK.title: 橡實想做大樹
zh-HK.text: {acorn:enter}橡實抬起頭，望着那兩棵又高又大的樹。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:live talk}[excited]「我都要好似佢哋咁大！即刻就要！」 {squirrel:enter}松鼠一蹦一跳地來了。[giggles]「即刻？細路，大樹都係由細細粒開始㗎——喺泥土下面。」 {squirrel:go to acorn}於是，在第一場雪來到之前，松鼠{squirrel:live bury}{sfx:pat}把橡實輕輕埋進鬆軟的泥土裏，拍、拍、拍。{squirrel:hearts}旁邊的{flower:enter}{acorn:go to flower}小花{flower:tint #BFE3FF}冷得發抖。「我陪你一齊等。」 她說完，{flower:live close hold}就把花瓣緊緊合上。{canvas:snow 0.6}接着，雪花飄下來了。{acorn:live wish hold}橡實緊緊閉上眼睛，許願說：「快高……長大……快高長大！」 可是，甚麼也沒有發生。[softly]那天沒有，第二天也沒有。她足足等了一整個冬天。{canvas:sunshine 0.9 20s}{sfx:birds}直到一天早上，太陽回來了，把雪都融掉。{flower:live close resume}小花張開了花瓣。橡實覺得腳趾癢癢的。{acorn:live wish resume}[gasps]「我變咗大樹未呀？」 {acorn:face surprised}{squirrel:face happy}{squirrel:live shake-head}「未呀。」 松鼠說，「嗰條係你嘅根，佢要先向下生。跟住，你嘅嫩芽先會向上冒出嚟。」 {acorn:face happy}{acorn:glow}先向下，再向上！[softly]這一次，橡實一點也不介意慢慢等了。
